text:
Priya: @here ok whos up for a lunchtime showdown tomorrow? Stadium Stairs sprint (10 flights) vs Office Boulder Fun-Roulette (20-min circuit). Loser buys recovery smoothies :tropical_drink:
Alex: Stairs for me. trying to beat last week's 1:45 PR. low effort cheering encouraged. :sweat_smile: 
Sam: Boulder circuit. need to work on footholds and dynos. can I bring my mini crash pad?
Lily: Ill do either. Also volunteering as DJ  winner picks the playlist.
Ben: Depends on weather (stairs outside are wet if its drizzly). If bouldering, can we set a "no heel hook" handicap for Ben? :grimacing:
Jordan: Ill join stairs, but can we add a foam-roll cooldown after? my hips hate me otherwise.
Priya: Signup: `@name - event - meetup - notes`
Alex: `@Alex - stairs - stadium steps - going for PR`
Sam: `@Sam - boulder - wall - bringing chalk + mini pad`
Lily: `@Lily - either - lobby - DJ + foam roller`
Ben: `@Ben - boulder - lobby - will bow out if rain`
Jordan: `@Jordan - stairs - stadium - foam roll post`
Priya: Nice. Currently 3 stairs / 2 boulder-ish / 1 flexible. Facilities okayed extra mats.
FitBot: Reminder created: "Stairs vs Boulder Lunch Challenge" tomorrow 12:25. React with :bell: to confirm.
Alex: :bell: good luck, Ben :muscle:
Ben: :face_with_thermometer: (jk) Ill bring ego and bandaids.
Sam: Also proposal: loser performs 1 karaoke song at next retro as penalty. Agree? :microphone:
Lily: :raised_hand: yes, and winner gets to pick smoothie flavor.
Priya: Deal. See you all 12:30. Bring shoes, chalk, and bad puns.
